Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Channel Communications team at Airbnb is responsible for driving positive conversation and buzz about Airbnb via social media, influencers and more, as well as maintaining and protecting our brand reputation across social media channels. The team is expanding its India presence, combining always-on reputation protection with channel growth, listening and insights for one of Airbnb's fastest-growing markets.

The Difference You Will Make

The Social Rapid Response team is looking for a Senior Social Media Associate who will be responsible for protecting and defending the Airbnb story on social media. This role pairs core Social Rapid Response coverage with support for Airbnb's India social presence, partnering closely with the India social lead on listening, insights, publishing and campaign engagement.

The ideal candidate is a social native with experience in social listening and responding rapidly to escalating issues and crises. We’re looking for someone who is detailed and solution-oriented, is comfortable moving at a fast pace and working with little manager supervision, has strong communication and interpersonal skills.

 

A Typical Day

  • Monitor emergent issues across social media channels
  • Proactively highlight and/or provide status updates on issues surfacing online to Lead(s)
  • Own day-to-day social listening for the India market, including competitive and cultural conversation tracking
  • Turn listening into insight; synthesize themes into regular recaps and ad hoc deep dives for comms, marketing and regional stakeholders
  • Provide publishing support for @airbnbindia, including scheduling, copy QA and channel hygiene
  • Support community engagement on @airbnbindia campaign moments - comment response, sentiment tracking and surfacing engagement-worthy UGC
  • Support Surprise & Delight workstreams as they surface on social
  • Ability to work cross functionally on communications initiatives involving Community Support and Trust operations, Policy, Regulatory, Corporate and Crisis Management
  • Draft copy and publish content across different channels
  • Key POC for publishing, engaging, accepting brand collabs and taking down posts as and when needed across brand social channels during APAC hours, in collaboration with marketing and comms social teams
  • Assist with developing playbooks and guidance on best practice
  • Assist with measuring campaign/project effectiveness
  • Support local APAC teams with reputational flagging and management
  • Support the team with the management of sensitive, high risk reactive & proactive communications on Airbnb’s social media channels 
  • Appropriately support on urgent posts, ‘handoffs’ and various escalations
  • Monitor queues and provide guidance to the team as needed
  • Highlight gaps in workflows for continuous improvement
  • Gather and analyze data for reporting, deep dives, performance insights and quality
  • Support upskilling and onboarding of new teammates
  • Support with writing response strategies
  • Support driving initiatives and projects with regional/global impacts
  • Support as a team representative during high-stakes and/or global events (ie. Olympics)
  • Assist Lead when out of office, as needed

About Zeta
Build the future of banking. 

Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.  

Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025. 

Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including: 

1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems 

2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments 

3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI 

4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking. 

5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024. 

6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US 

…and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking. 

We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work. 

If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground. If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.
 
 
About the role
Work directly with client SPOCs and internal stakeholders - not just support the team but assist in driving growth outcomes.
Build fluency in using AI tools as a force-multiplier for comms, copy, and research - a skill set that compounds well beyond this internship.
Get exposure to how new product lines get scoped and evaluated, from data to decision.


Responsibilities
• 

Leverage AI tools and skills to execute multiple ad hoc tasks in comms and copy campaign messaging, lifecycle communications, in-app copy, and more.

• 

Bring a sharp sense for what growth-initiative comms and copy actually work  writing built to convert, not just communicate.

• 

Work with client SPOCs and internal stakeholders to drive multiple growth 

initiatives and comms-led KPIs, end to end.

• 

Support data analysis and research initiatives, including exploratory work for new product lines.

Skills
• 

Strong written communication skills; comfortable adapting tone and format across customer, client, and internal audiences.

• 

Working familiarity with AI tools for content generation, research, and productivity, with genuine interest in using them to move faster.

• 

Comfortable with data — pulling insights, spotting patterns, and translating numbers into a narrative.

• 

Self-starter energy: able to work with ambiguity, juggle multiple threads, and drive things to closure with stakeholders.

Education and Qualification
• B.E/BTech or equivalent degree.

• 

A working sense of design - focused on creatives like layout and visual hierarchy 

• 

Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and templatization concepts (e.g., for email or in-app comms).

• 

Prior exposure to fintech, product, or growth/marketing through coursework, internships, or personal projects.

Compensation & Location:
• Duration: 4–6 months
• Location: Bangalore
• Stipend: Best in industry
